name: Secret Agent ~Kishi Gakuen no Shinobi Naru Mono~
original_name: Secret Agent～騎士学園の忍びなるもの～
source:
This love awakening is overwhelming.

The family of our protagonist -- Mikage Jin -- are descendants of a line of ninjas responsible for national security since the Edo era.
Jin was born and raised to follow in the footsteps of his secret agent mother as a ninja in training.
He's been ordered to infiltrate Touka Academy undercover in order to solve a series of incidents from a self-proclaimed "Bat."

Having successfully infiltrated the academy with his AI partner Momoka, he is able to carry out his mission without raising suspicion, while deepening his friendship with his classmate Kanon Mayfield, the knight Shirogane Kagura, captain Renjouji Mai, and junior Amenomori Yui.

However due to an unfortunate accident, Jin's identity is exposed, and with his true identity revealed, it would mean failure for his mission, however...

Please make me a ninja!!

Will Jin still be able to fulfill his mission?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467540/Secret_Agent/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这份初萌的爱意，令人难以招架。

主人公御影迅出身忍者世家，其家族自江户时代起便肩负保卫国家的职责。
在这样的家庭中出生长大的迅，为了继承身为秘密谍报员的母亲的事业，正在接受忍者训练。
为了调查自称“蝙蝠”的人物引发的一系列事件，他接到命令，以卧底身份潜入冬华学园。

迅与AI搭档桃香成功潜入学园，一边与同班同学卡农·梅菲尔德、骑士白钟神乐、团长莲城寺舞，以及学妹雨之森结衣加深友谊，一边不露声色地执行任务。

然而，一场意外暴露了迅的身份。真实身份一旦曝光，就意味着任务失败，可是……

“请让我成为忍者吧！”

迅还能顺利完成任务吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467540/Secret_Agent/]Steam[/url]]
